before.fixture: A competing real SQLite connection holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE while the opening connection requests WAL; native and Python-3.10-style errors both fail before correction.

checks: recover after a real competing writer releases its lock
restore default busy timeout after successful recovery
single deadline includes first wait, scheduler yield and later attempts
propagate non-BUSY errors and exhausted BUSY without masking them
uncontended WAL path uses one WAL SQL statement and no extra timeout statement

scope: Deterministic regression evidence for the observed startup failure; not retrieval accuracy, a throughput benchmark or a guarantee that all lock contention can be recovered.
